metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Titus, a leaf put back as it was, and a letter to Quiney.

yesterday: The jaw is still thick. The clove did less after the play than it did during it.
Titus at two. The hired men already had the name.
Thy went in where my was, and my is what stands. It is face down in the folder.
Quiney has the certificate asked for, dated the nineteenth.
